summary_md:
# Danske selskaber kom flot gennem regnskabssæsonen - men ingen køber deres aktier

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-09-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode looks back on a strong Danish Q2 earnings season. Price moves on results were very large: Maersk and Vestas beat expectations and rose sharply, Ambu disappointed and fell, and Novonesis raised its guidance. Lau Svendsen discussed the oil price, the Middle East and a possible short physical oil crisis, along with his shipping and oil holdings. Asbjørn Mørk (Danske Bank) called the macro backdrop late-cycle but strong, and said Danish and European banks are fundamentally well supported but now close to fully priced.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TEN — Tsakos | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Svendsen's target price is 70 and he sees a lot of upside; he calls it a long-term asset play on long-term contracts.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lau Svendsen holds Tsakos. He sees it as a long-term asset play with a target price of 70, well above today's price. It has almost no spot exposure and sails mainly on long-term contracts, so earnings are steadier than its spot-exposed tanker peers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tanker asset values fall
- if long-term contracts are renegotiated lower

> *"min målkurs for Tesagos er jo 70, så der er jo langt, langt op"*

---

### 🟡 BWLPG — BW LPG | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Svendsen is weighing whether to keep his BW LPG position as he reduces his shipping-heavy portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen says his portfolio is too heavily weighted towards shipping. BW LPG is the holding he is most undecided about; he notes it has its own market. This reads as a hold under review rather than a firm view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the LPG shipping market weakens
- if the shipping weighting is cut further

> *"Jeg sidder jo mest og tæller på knapper over BW"*

---

### 🟡 DNORD — DS Norden | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Dry-bulk rates are still healthy, which Svendsen reads as a sign of an economic upturn.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen keeps Norden. He argues that strong dry-bulk rates point to more trade in industrial and agricultural goods, which is good for Norden.

#### Sell Triggers

- if dry-bulk rates fall
- if the economy turns down

> *"Det er jo faktisk en indikator på, at verden er på vej mod en konjunkturopgang."*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — Mærsk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen sold half of his call-warrant position after the rally but would not be afraid to buy for the long term. Mørk says it is at the top of the cycle and now is not an obvious entry point.

#### Reasoning

Guests are split. Svendsen took partial profits after a roughly 27% run in two weeks, partly driven by short covering. He would buy only as a 5–8 year holding. Mørk says the cycle is at its peak and entry is not obvious. Jessen notes analysts are still negative (1 buy, 12 hold, 14 sell) and that the outcome depends on whether 2026 earnings repeat next year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if freight rates normalise
- if the Red Sea reopens
- if trade conflict escalates

> *"jeg vil ikke være bange for at købe den... Hvis du er meget lang"*

---

### 🟠 VWS — Vestas | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

ATP's Jessen is very positive after EBIT came in 117% above expectations and the onshore turnaround. Svendsen is not convinced about offshore.

#### Reasoning

Mark Jessen (ATP) praises the turnaround: onshore margins are strong, US demand holds up (for example in Texas) and the 10% EBIT target may come into reach. He warns against selling winners too early. Svendsen is not convinced offshore works yet and prefers suppliers. The net view is positive but not an explicit buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if offshore problems persist
- if the 10% EBIT target is missed
- if US policy turns against wind

> *"det går godt for Vestas, til trods for igen alt hvad der er uro"*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Svendsen prefers wind-sector suppliers such as NKT to turbine makers.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen argues the safer way to invest in wind is through suppliers and installers such as NKT rather than turbine makers. He does not own NKT himself.

#### Sell Triggers

- if wind build-out slows

> *"Altså NKT er jo en. Den har jeg ikke selv."*

---

### 🟠 CADLR — Cadeler | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Svendsen names installers such as Cadeler as the place to be in wind.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen prefers companies that install turbines, such as Cadeler, over turbine makers, which he sees as having unresolved problems.

#### Sell Triggers

- if offshore wind projects are cancelled

> *"Altså vi har Katteler og Bornør... Jeg tror, det er der, man skal være i det der."*

---

### 🟠 AMBU-B — Ambu | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

After a weak Q3 and a 15.8% drop it has become a show-me case; the long-term single-use device concept is still attractive.

#### Reasoning

Jessen says the business is not fundamentally broken, but the gap to its targets is wider than expected, so investors demand a higher risk premium. Mørk points to margin pressure in urology and one-off effects, but sees low penetration of a large market. The long-term case holds, but the uncertainty is higher.

#### Sell Triggers

- if urology margins keep falling
- if organic growth guidance is cut again

> *"Ambu er jo blevet sådan en show-me-case."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Mørk: strong economy, rising rates and good credit quality, but bank shares are close to fully priced.

#### Reasoning

Mørk says Danish banks have strong fundamentals and have had two years of rising earnings estimates. The main risk is that the ECB stops raising rates, which would stop estimates from rising further. After the rally, valuations are close to fully priced.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the ECB signals a halt to rate hikes
- if bank earnings estimates stop rising

> *"vi er jo helt åbenlyst til dig på noget, der minder om en færreprissætning på bankeaktierne"*

---
